purpose: decide whether the recorded Ehrhart data of five-part hive polytopes determines the codimension-five weights of a McMullen local formula
inputs: ../certified-special-case-check-1: the edges, lattice lengths and types of 2,000 full-dimensional five-part hive polytopes, with their certified linear coefficients
method: merge the types into isometry classes of (Z^6, standard inner product) by isotypes.canonical, build one linear equation per polytope, and reduce exactly over the rationals
